translations.literal: Zhou without way, left him.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhou had no virtue, so he left him.

translations.literal: Some said, Lü Shang recluse scholar, hidden seashore.

translations.idiomatic: Lü Shang said: “I have heard that the Western Earl is worthy and also good at caring for the old. Why not go there?”

translations.literal: Three persons for Xi Bo sought beautiful women rare objects, presented them to Zhou, to redeem Xi Bo.
translations.idiomatic: The three men sought beautiful women and rare objects for the Western Earl and presented them to King Zhou, thereby redeeming him.

translations.literal: Xi Bo able to come out, returned state.

translations.literal: Zhou Xi Bo Chang escaped You Li returned, with Lü Shang secretly plotted cultivated virtue to overthrow Shang government, their affairs many military authority and strange plans, therefore later generations speaking military and Zhou secret authority all revered Tai Gong as original strategy.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Earl of Zhou, Jichang, escaped from Youli, he and Lü Shang secretly planned to cultivate virtue and overturn Shang rule. Much of the matter involved military power and extraordinary stratagems, so later generations who spoke of war and Zhou’s hidden authority took Tai Gong as their root model.

context.next: 周西伯政平，及斷虞芮之訟，而詩人稱西伯受命曰文王。

translations.chinese: 周西伯政平，及斷虞芮之訟，而詩人稱西伯受命曰文王。
translations.literal: Zhou Xi Bo government peaceful, and judged Yu Rui dispute, and poets called Xi Bo received mandate called Wen Wang.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Earl ruled justly; after deciding the dispute of Yu and Rui, the poets praised him as King Wen.

translations.literal: Attacked Chong, Mi Xu, Quan Yi, greatly built Feng city.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Chong, Mishu, and Quanrong, and greatly expanded Feng.

context.previous: 周西伯政平，及斷虞芮之訟，而詩人稱西伯受命曰文王。

translations.literal: World three divided, its two returned Zhou, Tai Gong strategy plans resided many.
translations.idiomatic: When the world was divided into three, and two parts belonged to Zhou, Tai Gong’s plans were largely responsible.

translations.chinese: 文王崩，武王即位。
translations.literal: Wen Wang collapsed, Wu Wang ascended throne.
translations.idiomatic: When King Wen died, King Wu succeeded.

translations.literal: Ninth year, wanted to continue Wen Wang enterprise, east attacked to observe feudal lords gathered or not.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, he wanted to continue King Wen’s work and attacked eastward to see whether the feudal lords would gather.

translations.idiomatic: As the army set out, Master Shangfu held the yellow axe in his left hand and the white yak-tail banner in his right, and proclaimed: “Blue rhinoceroses, blue rhinoceroses, marshal all your multitudes and your boats and oars. Those who arrive late will be beheaded!”

translations.literal: Feudal lords all said: 'Zhou can attack also.'
translations.idiomatic: They all said, “Shang can be attacked.”

translations.literal: Scattered Lu Tai money, opened Ju Qiao grain, to relieve poor people.

translations.literal: Moved nine tripods, repaired Zhou government, with world renewed beginning.
translations.idiomatic: He moved the Nine Tripods, repaired the Zhou government, and began anew with the world.

context.previous: 封比干墓，釋箕子囚。

translations.literal: Therefore Wu Wang already pacified Shang and king world, enfeoffed Shi Shang Fu at Qi Ying Qiu.

translations.literal: Guest slept very peacefully, probably not go to state person also.'

translations.literal: Lai Hou came attacked, with him contended Ying Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord of Lai came to attack and contested Yingqiu with him.

context.next: 營丘邊萊。

translations.literal: Ying Qiu bordered Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqiu lay on the border with Lai.

context.previous: 萊侯來伐，與之爭營丘。

translations.idiomatic: The people of Lai were barbarians, and because the chaos under King Zhou had only just been settled, the far regions had not yet been brought into order, so they disputed Tai Gong’s claim to the state.

translations.literal: Tai Gong arrived state, repaired government, followed their customs, simplified their rites, opened merchant artisan occupations, facilitated fish salt profits, and people many returned Qi, Qi became great state.
translations.idiomatic: Once Tai Gong arrived, he governed well, adapted to local custom, simplified ritual, promoted trade and craft, and made use of fish and salt. The people of Qi therefore gathered to him in large numbers, and Qi became a great power.

context.next: 及周成王少時，管蔡作亂，淮夷畔周，乃使召康公命太公曰：「東至海，西至河，南至穆陵，北至無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之。」

translations.chinese: 及周成王少時，管蔡作亂，淮夷畔周，乃使召康公命太公曰：「東至海，西至河，南至穆陵，北至無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之。」
translations.literal: And Zhou Cheng Wang young time, Guan Cai made rebellion, Huai Yi rebelled Zhou, then sent Zhao Kang Gong commanded Tai Gong said: 'East to sea, west to river, south to Mu Ling, north to Wu Di, five marquises nine earls, truly can campaign them.'
translations.idiomatic: When King Cheng of Zhou was still young, Guan and Cai rebelled and the Huai Yi broke away. Zhou then sent Shao Gong to command Tai Gong, saying: “From the east to the sea, from the west to the Yellow River, from the south to Muling, and from the north to Wudi, the five lords and nine bo should all be subject to your punishment.”

context.previous: 太公至國，修政，因其俗，簡其禮，通商工之業，便魚鹽之利，而人民多歸齊，齊為大國。
context.next: 齊由此得征伐，為大國。

translations.chinese: 齊由此得征伐，為大國。
translations.literal: Qi thereby got to campaign, became great state.
translations.idiomatic: From this, Qi gained the right of punitive expedition and became a great power.

context.previous: 及周成王少時，管蔡作亂，淮夷畔周，乃使召康公命太公曰：「東至海，西至河，南至穆陵，北至無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之。」
context.next: 都營丘。

translations.chinese: 都營丘。
translations.literal: Capital Ying Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: Its capital was Yingqiu.

context.previous: 齊由此得征伐，為大國。

translations.chinese: 蓋太公之卒百有餘年，子丁公呂伋立。
translations.literal: Probably Tai Gong died over one hundred years, son Ding Gong Lü Ji established.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Gong died more than a hundred years later, and his son Duke Ding, Lü Ji, succeeded him.

context.next: 丁公卒，子乙公得立。

translations.chinese: 丁公卒，子乙公得立。
translations.literal: Ding Gong died, son Yi Gong De established.
translations.idiomatic: After Duke Ding died, his son Duke Yi succeeded.

context.previous: 蓋太公之卒百有餘年，子丁公呂伋立。
context.next: 乙公卒，子癸公慈母立。

translations.chinese: 乙公卒，子癸公慈母立。
translations.literal: Yi Gong died, son Gui Gong Ci Mu established.
translations.idiomatic: After Duke Yi died, his son Duke Gui, Cimu, succeeded.

context.previous: 丁公卒，子乙公得立。
context.next: 癸公卒，子哀公不辰立。

translations.chinese: 癸公卒，子哀公不辰立。
translations.literal: Gui Gong died, son Ai Gong Bu Chen established.
translations.idiomatic: After Duke Gui died, his son Duke Ai, Buchen, succeeded.

context.previous: 乙公卒，子癸公慈母立。

translations.chinese: 哀公時，紀侯譖之周，周烹哀公而立其弟靜，是為胡公。
translations.literal: Ai Gong time, Ji Hou slandered him to Zhou, Zhou boiled Ai Gong and established his younger brother Jing, this was Hu Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Ai’s time, Lord Ji slandered him to Zhou. Zhou had Duke Ai boiled to death and installed his younger brother Jing, who became Duke Hu.

context.next: 胡公徙都薄泵，而當周夷王之時。

translations.chinese: 胡公徙都薄泵，而當周夷王之時。
translations.literal: Hu Gong moved capital Bo Bei, and met Zhou Yi Wang time.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Hu moved the capital to Bohai, during the reign of King Yi of Zhou.

context.previous: 哀公時，紀侯譖之周，周烹哀公而立其弟靜，是為胡公。

translations.chinese: 哀公之同母少弟山怨胡公，乃與其黨率營丘人襲攻殺胡公而自立，是為獻公。
translations.literal: Ai Gong same mother younger brother Shan resented Hu Gong, then with his faction led Ying Qiu people surprise attacked killed Hu Gong and self established, this was Xian Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Ai’s younger full brother Shan resented Duke Hu, so he and his faction led the people of Yingqiu in a surprise attack that killed Duke Hu and established Shan himself as Duke Xian.

context.next: 獻公元年，盡逐胡公子，因徙薄泵都，治臨菑。

translations.chinese: 獻公元年，盡逐胡公子，因徙薄泵都，治臨菑。
translations.literal: Xian Gong first year, completely expelled Hu Gong sons, therefore moved Bo Bei capital, governed Lin Zi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Xian, he drove out all the sons of Duke Hu and then moved the capital to Bohai and governed from Linzi.

context.previous: 哀公之同母少弟山怨胡公，乃與其黨率營丘人襲攻殺胡公而自立，是為獻公。

translations.chinese: 九年，獻公卒，子武公壽立。
translations.literal: Ninth year, Xian Gong died, son Wu Gong Shou established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Duke Xian died, and his son Duke Wu, Shou, succeeded.

context.next: 武公九年，周厲王出奔，居彘。

translations.chinese: 武公九年，周厲王出奔，居彘。
translations.literal: Wu Gong ninth year, Zhou Li Wang fled, resided Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Duke Wu, King Li of Zhou fled and lived in Zhi.

context.previous: 九年，獻公卒，子武公壽立。
context.next: 十年，王室亂，大臣行政，號曰「共和」。

translations.chinese: 十年，王室亂，大臣行政，號曰「共和」。
translations.literal: Tenth year, royal house chaotic, ministers administered government, called 'Gong He'.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, when the royal house was in disorder, the ministers exercised power and called it “Gonghe.”

context.previous: 武公九年，周厲王出奔，居彘。
context.next: 二十四年，周宣王初立。

translations.chinese: 二十四年，周宣王初立。
translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, Zhou Xuan Wang initially established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, King Xuan of Zhou first ascended the throne.

context.previous: 十年，王室亂，大臣行政，號曰「共和」。

translations.chinese: 二十六年，武公卒，子厲公無忌立。
translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, Wu Gong died, son Li Gong Wu Ji established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Duke Wu died, and his son Duke Li, Wuxi, succeeded.

context.next: 厲公暴虐，故胡公子復入齊，齊人欲立之，乃與攻殺厲公。

translations.chinese: 厲公暴虐，故胡公子復入齊，齊人欲立之，乃與攻殺厲公。
translations.literal: Li Gong tyrannical cruel, therefore Hu Gong son again entered Qi, Qi people wanted to establish him, then with attacked killed Li Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Li was cruel and tyrannical, so the sons of Duke Hu re-entered Qi. The people of Qi wanted to install one of them, and together they attacked and killed Duke Li.

context.previous: 二十六年，武公卒，子厲公無忌立。
context.next: 胡公子亦戰死。

translations.chinese: 胡公子亦戰死。
translations.literal: Hu Gong son also battle died.
translations.idiomatic: The son of Duke Hu also died in battle.

context.previous: 厲公暴虐，故胡公子復入齊，齊人欲立之，乃與攻殺厲公。
context.next: 齊人乃立厲公子赤為君，是為文公，而誅殺厲公者七十人。

translations.chinese: 齊人乃立厲公子赤為君，是為文公，而誅殺厲公者七十人。
translations.literal: Qi people then established Li Gong son Chi as lord, this was Wen Gong, and executed killed Li Gong persons seventy.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qi then installed Duke Li’s son Chi as lord, making him Duke Wen, and killed seventy men involved in Duke Li’s death.

context.previous: 胡公子亦戰死。

translations.chinese: 文公十二年卒，子成公脫立。
translations.literal: Wen Gong twelfth year died, son Cheng Gong Tuo established.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve years later, Duke Wen died and his son Duke Cheng, Tuo, succeeded.

context.next: 成公九年卒，子莊公購立。

translations.chinese: 成公九年卒，子莊公購立。
translations.literal: Cheng Gong ninth year died, son Zhuang Gong Gou established.
translations.idiomatic: Nine years later, Duke Cheng died and his son Duke Zhuang, Gou, succeeded.

context.previous: 文公十二年卒，子成公脫立。

translations.chinese: 莊公二十四年，犬戎殺幽王，周東徙雒。
translations.literal: Zhuang Gong twenty-fourth year, Quan Rong killed You Wang, Zhou east moved Luo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Duke Zhuang, the Quanrong killed King You, and Zhou moved east to Luo.

context.next: 秦始列為諸侯。

translations.chinese: 秦始列為諸侯。
translations.literal: Qin began ranked as feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Qin was first enfeoffed as a feudal state.

context.previous: 莊公二十四年，犬戎殺幽王，周東徙雒。
context.next: 五十六年，晉弒其君昭侯。

translations.chinese: 五十六年，晉弒其君昭侯。
translations.literal: Fifty-sixth year, Jin assassinated their lord Zhao Hou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year, the state of Jin assassinated its lord, Duke Zhao.

context.previous: 秦始列為諸侯。

translations.chinese: 六十四年，莊公卒，子釐公祿甫立。
translations.literal: Sixty-fourth year, Zhuang Gong died, son Xi Gong Lu Fu established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-fourth year, Duke Zhuang died and his son Duke Xi, Lüfu, succeeded.

translations.chinese: 釐公九年，魯隱公初立。
translations.literal: Xi Gong ninth year, Lu Yin Gong initially established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Duke Xi, Duke Yin of Lu first came to the throne.

context.next: 十九年，魯桓公弒其兄隱公而自立為君。

translations.chinese: 十九年，魯桓公弒其兄隱公而自立為君。
translations.literal: Nineteenth year, Lu Huan Gong assassinated his elder brother Yin Gong and self established as lord.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Duke Huan of Lu assassinated his elder brother Duke Yin and made himself lord.

context.previous: 釐公九年，魯隱公初立。

translations.chinese: 二十五年，北戎伐齊。
translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, northern Rong attacked Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, the northern Rong attacked Qi.

context.next: 鄭使太子忽來救齊，齊欲妻之。

translations.chinese: 鄭使太子忽來救齊，齊欲妻之。
translations.literal: Zheng sent crown prince Hu to save Qi, Qi wanted to marry him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng sent the crown prince Hu to rescue Qi, and Qi wanted to marry him to a woman.

context.previous: 二十五年，北戎伐齊。
context.next: 忽曰：「鄭小齊大，非我敵。」

translations.chinese: 忽曰：「鄭小齊大，非我敵。」
translations.literal: Hu said: 'Zheng small Qi big, not my match.'
translations.idiomatic: Hu said: “Zheng is small and Qi is large. I am no match for it.”

context.previous: 鄭使太子忽來救齊，齊欲妻之。
context.next: 遂辭之。

translations.chinese: 遂辭之。
translations.literal: Then declined it.
translations.idiomatic: So he declined.

context.previous: 忽曰：「鄭小齊大，非我敵。」

translations.chinese: 三十二年，釐公同母弟夷仲年死。
translations.literal: Thirty-second year, Xi Gong same mother younger brother Yi Zhong year died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, Duke Xi’s younger full brother Yizhongnian died.

context.next: 其子曰公孫無知，釐公愛之，令其秩服奉養比太子。

translations.chinese: 其子曰公孫無知，釐公愛之，令其秩服奉養比太子。
translations.literal: His son called Gong Sun Wu Zhi, Xi Gong loved him, ordered his rank clothing support compare to crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: His son was called Gongsun Wuzhi. Duke Xi favored him and ordered that his rank, clothing, and support be equal to those of the crown prince.

context.previous: 三十二年，釐公同母弟夷仲年死。

translations.chinese: 三十三年，釐公卒，太子諸兒立，是為襄公。
translations.literal: Thirty-third year, Xi Gong died, crown prince Zhu Er established, this was Xiang Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, Duke Xi died and the crown prince Zhu’er succeeded; this was Duke Xiang.

translations.chinese: 襄公元年，始為太子時，嘗與無知鬬，及立，絀無知秩服，無知怨。
translations.literal: Xiang Gong first year, when began as crown prince time, once with Wu Zhi fought, and established, reduced Wu Zhi rank clothing, Wu Zhi resented.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Xiang, when he had first been crown prince, he once fought with Wuzhi. After he came to the throne, he reduced Wuzhi’s rank and clothing, and Wuzhi resented it.

translations.chinese: 四年，魯桓公與夫人如齊。
translations.literal: Fourth year, Lu Huan Gong with consort went to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Duke Huan of Lu came to Qi with his wife.

context.next: 齊襄公故嘗私通魯夫人。

translations.chinese: 齊襄公故嘗私通魯夫人。
translations.literal: Qi Xiang Gong therefore once privately communicated with Lu consort.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiang of Qi had once secretly been intimate with the wife of the Duke of Lu.

context.previous: 四年，魯桓公與夫人如齊。
context.next: 魯夫人者，襄公女弟也，自釐公時嫁為魯桓公婦，及桓公來而襄公復通焉。

translations.chinese: 魯夫人者，襄公女弟也，自釐公時嫁為魯桓公婦，及桓公來而襄公復通焉。
translations.literal: Lu consort, Xiang Gong younger sister also, from Xi Gong time married as Lu Huan Gong wife, and Huan Gong came and Xiang Gong again communicated with her.
translations.idiomatic: The lady of Lu was Duke Xiang’s younger sister. She had been married to Duke Huan of Lu during Duke Xi’s reign, and when Duke Huan came, Duke Xiang again became intimate with her.

context.previous: 齊襄公故嘗私通魯夫人。
context.next: 魯桓公知之，怒夫人，夫人以告齊襄公。

translations.chinese: 魯桓公知之，怒夫人，夫人以告齊襄公。
translations.literal: Lu Huan Gong knew this, angered consort, consort told Qi Xiang Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Lu learned of it and was angry with his wife. She told Duke Xiang of Qi.

context.previous: 魯夫人者，襄公女弟也，自釐公時嫁為魯桓公婦，及桓公來而襄公復通焉。
context.next: 齊襄公與魯君飲，醉之，使力士彭生抱上魯君車，因拉殺魯桓公，桓公下車則死矣。

translations.chinese: 齊襄公與魯君飲，醉之，使力士彭生抱上魯君車，因拉殺魯桓公，桓公下車則死矣。
translations.literal: Qi Xiang Gong with Lu lord drank, intoxicated him, made strong man Peng Sheng embrace carry Lu lord chariot, then pulled killed Lu Huan Gong, Huan Gong descended chariot then died.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiang of Qi drank with the Duke of Lu, intoxicated him, and had the strongman Peng Sheng carry the Duke of Lu onto the carriage. Peng Sheng then twisted and killed Duke Huan of Lu; by the time the duke fell from the carriage, he was already dead.

context.previous: 魯桓公知之，怒夫人，夫人以告齊襄公。
context.next: 魯人以為讓，而齊襄公殺彭生以謝魯。

translations.chinese: 魯人以為讓，而齊襄公殺彭生以謝魯。
translations.literal: Lu people considered it a reproach, and Qi Xiang Gong killed Peng Sheng to apologize to Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Lu thought this was rude, and Duke Xiang of Qi killed Peng Sheng to apologize to Lu.

context.previous: 齊襄公與魯君飲，醉之，使力士彭生抱上魯君車，因拉殺魯桓公，桓公下車則死矣。

translations.chinese: 八年，伐紀，紀遷去其邑。
translations.literal: Eighth year, attacked Ji, Ji moved away their city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, he attacked Ji, and the people of Ji moved away from their city.

translations.chinese: 十二年，初，襄公使連稱、管至父戍葵丘，瓜時而往，及瓜而代。
translations.literal: Twelfth year, initially, Xiang Gong sent Lian Cheng, Guan Zhi Fu garrison Kui Qiu, melon time went, and melon time replaced.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, at first Duke Xiang sent Lian Cheng and Guan Zifu to garrison Kuiqiu. They were to go when the gourds ripened and be replaced when the next crop came in.

context.next: 往戍一歲，卒瓜時而公弗為發代。

translations.chinese: 往戍一歲，卒瓜時而公弗為發代。
translations.literal: Went garrison one year, ended melon time and duke not for sent replacement.
translations.idiomatic: They had garrisoned for a year, but when the time came for the gourds, the duke still did not send replacements.

context.previous: 十二年，初，襄公使連稱、管至父戍葵丘，瓜時而往，及瓜而代。
context.next: 或為請代，公弗許。

translations.chinese: 或為請代，公弗許。
translations.literal: Someone for requested replacement, duke not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Some petitioned for replacement, but the duke did not allow it.

context.previous: 往戍一歲，卒瓜時而公弗為發代。
context.next: 故此二人怒，因公孫無知謀作亂。

translations.chinese: 故此二人怒，因公孫無知謀作亂。
translations.literal: Therefore these two angered, through Gong Sun Wu Zhi plotted to make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: So the two men became angry and planned a rebellion with Gongsun Wuzhi.

context.previous: 或為請代，公弗許。
context.next: 連稱有從妹在公宮，無寵，使之閒襄公，曰「事成以女為無知夫人」。

translations.chinese: 連稱有從妹在公宮，無寵，使之閒襄公，曰「事成以女為無知夫人」。
translations.literal: Lian Cheng had younger maternal sister in duke palace, no favor, made her spy Xiang Gong, said 'matter succeeds with woman as Wu Zhi wife'.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Cheng had a female cousin in the palace who was out of favor, so he used her to spy on Duke Xiang and said: “If the affair succeeds, I will give you to Wuzhi as his wife.”

context.previous: 故此二人怒，因公孫無知謀作亂。
context.next: 冬十二月，襄公游姑棼，遂獵沛丘。

translations.chinese: 冬十二月，襄公游姑棼，遂獵沛丘。
translations.literal: Winter twelfth month, Xiang Gong toured Gu Fen, then hunted Pei Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month of winter, Duke Xiang traveled to Gufen and then hunted at Peiqiu.

context.previous: 連稱有從妹在公宮，無寵，使之閒襄公，曰「事成以女為無知夫人」。
context.next: 見彘，從者曰「彭生」。

translations.chinese: 見彘，從者曰「彭生」。
translations.literal: Saw pig, followers said 'Peng Sheng'.
translations.idiomatic: He saw a boar. The attendants said, “That is Peng Sheng.”

context.previous: 冬十二月，襄公游姑棼，遂獵沛丘。
context.next: 公怒，射之，彘人立而啼。

translations.chinese: 公怒，射之，彘人立而啼。
translations.literal: Duke angered, shot it, pig person stood and cried.
translations.idiomatic: The duke was angered and shot at it, but the boar stood upright like a person and screamed.

context.previous: 見彘，從者曰「彭生」。
context.next: 公懼，墜車傷足，失屨。

translations.chinese: 公懼，墜車傷足，失屨。
translations.literal: Duke feared, fell from chariot injured foot, lost shoe.
translations.idiomatic: The duke was frightened, fell from the carriage, and hurt his foot, losing his shoe.

context.previous: 公怒，射之，彘人立而啼。
context.next: 反而鞭主屨者茀三百。

translations.chinese: 反而鞭主屨者茀三百。
translations.literal: Returned and whipped shoe master Fu three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On returning, he had the shoe-keeper Fu flogged three hundred times.

context.previous: 公懼，墜車傷足，失屨。
context.next: 茀出宮。

translations.chinese: 茀出宮。
translations.literal: Fu exited palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fu left the palace.

context.previous: 反而鞭主屨者茀三百。
context.next: 而無知、連稱、管至父等聞公傷，乃遂率其眾襲宮。

translations.chinese: 而無知、連稱、管至父等聞公傷，乃遂率其眾襲宮。
translations.literal: And Wu Zhi, Lian Cheng, Guan Zhi Fu etc heard duke injured, then then led their masses surprise attacked palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzhi, Lian Cheng, Guan Zifu, and the others heard that the duke had been hurt, they at once led their men to attack the palace.

context.previous: 茀出宮。
context.next: 逢主屨茀，茀曰：「且無入驚宮，驚宮未易入也。」

translations.chinese: 逢主屨茀，茀曰：「且無入驚宮，驚宮未易入也。」
translations.literal: Met shoe master Fu, Fu said: 'Moreover do not enter alarm palace, alarming palace not easy enter also.'
translations.idiomatic: Meeting Fu outside the palace, Fu said: “Do not rush into the palace in alarm. Once the palace is alarmed, it will not be easy to enter.”

context.previous: 而無知、連稱、管至父等聞公傷，乃遂率其眾襲宮。
context.next: 無知弗信，茀示之創，乃信之。

translations.chinese: 無知弗信，茀示之創，乃信之。
translations.literal: Wu Zhi not believed, Fu showed him wound, then believed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhi did not believe him, but Fu showed him the wound, and then he believed.

context.previous: 逢主屨茀，茀曰：「且無入驚宮，驚宮未易入也。」
context.next: 待宮外，令茀先入。

translations.idiomatic: Now the ministers should establish the proper son of the duke. I will listen to whatever is commanded.”

translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Duke Xiang drunkenly killed Duke Huan of Lu, had relations with his wife, and carried out killings that were not in keeping with duty, while indulging in women and repeatedly deceiving his ministers, his younger brothers feared that disaster would reach them, so his younger brother Jiu fled to Lu.

translations.idiomatic: His mother was a woman from Lu.

translations.idiomatic: Xiaobai from a young age was good at befriending the grand master Gao Xi.

translations.idiomatic: Xiaobai pretended to be dead, and Guan Zhong sent a person to gallop and report to Lu.

translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan was hit by the hook and pretended to be dead to mislead Guan Zhong. Then he was loaded into a warm chariot and galloped away. He also had Gao and Guo as internal response. Therefore, he got to enter first and be established, and sent troops to resist Lu.

translations.idiomatic: In autumn, they battled with Lu at Ganshi. The Lu troops were defeated and fled, and the Qi troops ambushed and cut off Lu's return road.

translations.idiomatic: Qi sent a letter to Lu and said: 'Zijiu is my brother. I cannot bear to execute him. Please let Lu kill him themselves.

translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hu and Guan Zhong are enemies. Please let me get them and satisfy my heart by pickling them in the vat.'

translations.literal: Not so, will surround Lu.'
translations.idiomatic: If not so, I will surround Lu.'

translations.idiomatic: When Duke Huan was established, he sent troops to attack the state of Lu, and in his heart he wanted to kill Guan Zhong.

translations.idiomatic: Bao Shuya said: 'I, your minister, was fortunate to follow you, my lord, and you were finally established as the lord.

translations.idiomatic: You, my lord, are honored, and I, your minister, have nothing with which to increase you, my lord.'

translations.idiomatic: If you, my lord, are about to govern Qi, then Gao Xi and Shuya are sufficient.'

translations.idiomatic: If you, my lord, moreover want to be a hegemon king, it is not possible without Guan Yiwu.'

translations.literal: Yi Wu where resides states states heavy, cannot lose also.'
translations.idiomatic: Wherever Yiwu resides, the states become heavy. He cannot be lost.'

translations.literal: Therefore Huan Gong followed it.

translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan had already gotten Guan Zhong, and together with Bao Shu, Xi Peng, and Gao Xi, he repaired the government of the state of Qi. He connected the troops of the five families, set the profits of light and heavy, fish and salt, to relieve the poor, and gave salary to the worthy and able. The people of Qi were all pleased.

translations.idiomatic: Then Cao Mo put away the dagger, faced north, and took the minister's position.

translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords heard of it, and all trusted Qi and wanted to attach themselves to it.

translations.literal: Li Chu said: 'Kong Qiu knows rites but cowardly, please command Lai people make music, thereby seize Lu lord, can obtain ambition.'
translations.idiomatic: Lichu said: 'Kong Qiu knows the rites but is cowardly. Please command the people of Lai to make music, and thereby seize the lord of Lu, and you can obtain your ambition.'

context.previous: 四十八年，與魯定公好會夾谷。
context.next: 景公害孔丘相魯，懼其霸，故從犁鉏之計。

translations.chinese: 景公害孔丘相魯，懼其霸，故從犁鉏之計。
translations.literal: Jing Gong hated Kong Qiu assisted Lu, feared his hegemony, therefore followed Li Chu plan.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing hated that Kong Qiu was assisting the state of Lu, feared his hegemony, and therefore followed Lichu's plan.

context.previous: 犁鉏曰：「孔丘知禮而怯，請令萊人為樂，因執魯君，可得志。」
context.next: 方會，進萊樂，孔子歷階上，使有司執萊人斬之，以禮讓景公。

translations.chinese: 方會，進萊樂，孔子歷階上，使有司執萊人斬之，以禮讓景公。
translations.literal: Just meeting, advanced Lai music, Kong Zi ascended stairs, made officials seize Lai people behead them, with rites yield Jing Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Just as they were meeting, they advanced the music of Lai, and Kongzi ascended the stairs, made the officials seize the people of Lai and behead them, and with the rites yielded to Duke Jing.

context.previous: 景公害孔丘相魯，懼其霸，故從犁鉏之計。
context.next: 景公慚，乃歸魯侵地以謝，而罷去。

translations.chinese: 景公慚，乃歸魯侵地以謝，而罷去。
translations.literal: Jing Gong ashamed, then returned Lu invaded lands to apologize, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing was ashamed, and then returned the invaded lands of Lu to apologize, and departed.

context.previous: 方會，進萊樂，孔子歷階上，使有司執萊人斬之，以禮讓景公。
context.next: 是歲，晏嬰卒。

translations.chinese: 是歲，晏嬰卒。
translations.literal: This year, Yan Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, Yan Ying died.

context.previous: 景公慚，乃歸魯侵地以謝，而罷去。

translations.chinese: 五十五年，范、中行反其君於晉，晉攻之急，來請粟。
translations.literal: Fifty-fifth year, Fan, Zhong Xing rebelled their lord in Jin, Jin attacked them urgently, came request grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, Fan and Zhongxing rebelled against their lord in Jin, Jin attacked them urgently, and they came to request grain.

context.next: 田乞欲為亂，樹黨於逆臣，說景公曰：「范、中行數有德於齊，不可不救。」

translations.chinese: 田乞欲為亂，樹黨於逆臣，說景公曰：「范、中行數有德於齊，不可不救。」
translations.literal: Tian Qi wanted make chaos, established party among rebellious ministers, persuaded Jing Gong said: 'Fan, Zhong Xing repeatedly had virtue toward Qi, cannot not save.'
translations.idiomatic: Tian Qi wanted to make chaos, established a party among the rebellious ministers, and persuaded Duke Jing, saying: 'Fan and Zhongxing have repeatedly shown virtue toward Qi, and we cannot not save them.'

context.previous: 五十五年，范、中行反其君於晉，晉攻之急，來請粟。
context.next: 及使乞救而輸之粟。

translations.chinese: 及使乞救而輸之粟。
translations.literal: And made Qi save and transported grain to them.
translations.idiomatic: And he made Qi save them and transported grain to them.

context.previous: 田乞欲為亂，樹黨於逆臣，說景公曰：「范、中行數有德於齊，不可不救。」

translations.chinese: 五十八年夏，景公夫人燕姬適子死。
translations.literal: Fifty-eighth year summer, Jing Gong lady Yan Ji legitimate son died.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifty-eighth year, the legitimate son of Duke Jing's lady Yan Ji died.

context.next: 景公寵妾芮姬生子荼，荼少，其母賤，無行，諸大夫恐其為嗣，乃言願擇諸子長賢者為太子。

translations.chinese: 景公寵妾芮姬生子荼，荼少，其母賤，無行，諸大夫恐其為嗣，乃言願擇諸子長賢者為太子。
translations.literal: Jing Gong favored concubine Rui Ji gave birth son Tu, Tu young, his mother base, no conduct, various grand masters feared him as successor, then said wished select various sons eldest worthy one as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing's favored concubine Rui Ji gave birth to a son Tu. Tu was young, his mother was base, and had no conduct. The various grand masters feared him as successor, and then said they wished to select among the various sons the eldest worthy one as crown prince.

context.previous: 五十八年夏，景公夫人燕姬適子死。
context.next: 景公老，惡言嗣事，又愛荼母，欲立之，憚發之口，乃謂諸大夫曰：「為樂耳，國何患無君乎？」

translations.chinese: 景公老，惡言嗣事，又愛荼母，欲立之，憚發之口，乃謂諸大夫曰：「為樂耳，國何患無君乎？」
translations.literal: Jing Gong old, hated speak succession matters, also loved Tu mother, wanted establish him, dreaded speak it, then told various grand masters said: 'for pleasure only, state what worry no lord?'
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing was old, hated to speak of succession matters, and also loved Tu's mother, wanted to establish him, but dreaded to speak of it, and then told the various grand masters, saying: 'It is only for pleasure. What does the state worry about having no lord?'

context.previous: 景公寵妾芮姬生子荼，荼少，其母賤，無行，諸大夫恐其為嗣，乃言願擇諸子長賢者為太子。
context.next: 秋，景公病，命國惠子、高昭子立少子荼為太子，逐群公子，遷之萊。

translations.chinese: 秋，景公病，命國惠子、高昭子立少子荼為太子，逐群公子，遷之萊。
translations.literal: Autumn, Jing Gong ill, commanded Guo Hui Zi, Gao Zhao Zi establish youngest son Tu as crown prince, expelled group duke sons, moved them to Lai.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, Duke Jing was ill, commanded Guohuizi and Gao Zhaozhi to establish the youngest son Tu as crown prince, expelled the various duke's sons, and moved them to Lai.

context.previous: 景公老，惡言嗣事，又愛荼母，欲立之，憚發之口，乃謂諸大夫曰：「為樂耳，國何患無君乎？」
context.next: 景公卒，太子荼立，是為晏孺子。

translations.chinese: 景公卒，太子荼立，是為晏孺子。
translations.literal: Jing Gong died, crown prince Tu established, this was Yan Ru Zi.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing died, and Crown Prince Tu was established. This was Yan Ruzi.

context.previous: 秋，景公病，命國惠子、高昭子立少子荼為太子，逐群公子，遷之萊。
context.next: 冬，未葬，而群公子畏誅，皆出亡。

translations.chinese: 冬，未葬，而群公子畏誅，皆出亡。
translations.literal: Winter, not yet buried, and group duke sons feared execution, all fled.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, before he was buried, the various duke's sons feared execution, and all fled.

context.previous: 景公卒，太子荼立，是為晏孺子。
context.next: 荼諸異母兄公子壽、駒、黔奔衛，公子駔、陽生奔魯。

translations.chinese: 荼諸異母兄公子壽、駒、黔奔衛，公子駔、陽生奔魯。
translations.literal: Tu various different mother elder brothers duke son Shou, Ju, Qian fled Wei, duke son Zhu, Yang Sheng fled Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Tu's various elder brothers from different mothers, the duke's sons Shou, Ju, and Qian, fled to Wei, and the duke's sons Zhu and Yang Sheng fled to Lu.

context.previous: 冬，未葬，而群公子畏誅，皆出亡。
context.next: 萊人歌之曰：「景公死乎弗與埋，三軍事乎弗與謀，師乎師乎，胡黨之乎？」

translations.chinese: 萊人歌之曰：「景公死乎弗與埋，三軍事乎弗與謀，師乎師乎，胡黨之乎？」
translations.literal: Lai people sang it said: 'Jing Gong died not with bury, three armies matters not with plan, army army, why follow him?'
translations.idiomatic: The people of Lai sang of it, saying: 'Duke Jing died, and we were not with him to bury him. The three armies' matters, and we were not with them to plan them. Army, army, why do we follow him?'

context.previous: 荼諸異母兄公子壽、駒、黔奔衛，公子駔、陽生奔魯。

translations.chinese: 晏孺子元年春，田乞偽事高、國者，每朝，乞驂乘，言曰：「子得君，大夫皆自危，欲謀作亂。」
translations.literal: Yan Ru Zi first year spring, Tian Qi falsely served Gao, Guo ones, every court, Qi outside driver, said: 'you got lord, grand masters all self danger, want plot make chaos.'
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Yan Ruzi, Tian Qi falsely served the Gao and Guo ones. Every court, Qi rode as outside driver, and said: 'You have obtained the lord, and the grand masters all feel themselves in danger, and want to plot to make chaos.'

context.next: 又謂諸大夫曰：「高昭子可畏，及未發，先之。」

translations.chinese: 又謂諸大夫曰：「高昭子可畏，及未發，先之。」
translations.literal: Also told various grand masters said: 'Gao Zhao Zi can fear, and not yet issued, first him.'
translations.idiomatic: He also told the various grand masters, saying: 'Gao Zhaozhi is to be feared. Before he has not yet issued, let us first him.'

context.previous: 晏孺子元年春，田乞偽事高、國者，每朝，乞驂乘，言曰：「子得君，大夫皆自危，欲謀作亂。」
context.next: 大夫從之。

translations.chinese: 大夫從之。
translations.literal: Grand masters followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The grand masters followed him.

context.previous: 又謂諸大夫曰：「高昭子可畏，及未發，先之。」
context.next: 六月，田乞、鮑牧乃與大夫以兵入公宮，攻高昭子。

translations.chinese: 六月，田乞、鮑牧乃與大夫以兵入公宮，攻高昭子。
translations.literal: Sixth month, Tian Qi, Bao Mu then with grand masters with troops entered duke palace, attacked Gao Zhao Zi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tian Qi and Bao Mu then with the grand masters with troops entered the duke's palace and attacked Gao Zhaozhi.

context.previous: 大夫從之。
context.next: 昭子聞之，與國惠子救公。

translations.chinese: 昭子聞之，與國惠子救公。
translations.literal: Zhao Zi heard it, with Guo Hui Zi saved duke.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozhi heard of it, and with Guohuizi saved the duke.

context.previous: 六月，田乞、鮑牧乃與大夫以兵入公宮，攻高昭子。
context.next: 公師敗，田乞之徒追之，國惠子奔莒，遂反殺高昭子。

translations.chinese: 公師敗，田乞之徒追之，國惠子奔莒，遂反殺高昭子。
translations.literal: Duke army defeated, Tian Qi followers pursued them, Guo Hui Zi fled Ju, then conversely killed Gao Zhao Zi.
translations.idiomatic: The duke's army was defeated, Tian Qi's followers pursued them, Guohuizi fled to Ju, and then conversely killed Gao Zhaozhi.

context.previous: 昭子聞之，與國惠子救公。
context.next: 晏圉奔魯。

translations.chinese: 晏圉奔魯。
translations.literal: Yan Yu fled Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yu fled to Lu.

context.previous: 公師敗，田乞之徒追之，國惠子奔莒，遂反殺高昭子。
context.next: 八月，齊秉意茲。

translations.chinese: 八月，齊秉意茲。
translations.literal: Eighth month, Qi took Yi Zi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Qi took Yizi.

context.previous: 晏圉奔魯。
context.next: 田乞敗二相，乃使人之魯召公子陽生。

translations.chinese: 田乞敗二相，乃使人之魯召公子陽生。
translations.literal: Tian Qi defeated two ministers, then sent people to Lu summoned duke son Yang Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Qi defeated the two ministers, and then sent people to Lu to summon the duke's son Yang Sheng.

context.previous: 八月，齊秉意茲。
context.next: 陽生至齊，私匿田乞家。

translations.chinese: 陽生至齊，私匿田乞家。
translations.literal: Yang Sheng arrived Qi, privately hid Tian Qi home.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng arrived in Qi and privately hid in Tian Qi's home.

context.previous: 田乞敗二相，乃使人之魯召公子陽生。
context.next: 十月戊子，田乞請諸大夫曰：「常之母有魚菽之祭，幸來會飲。」

translations.chinese: 十月戊子，田乞請諸大夫曰：「常之母有魚菽之祭，幸來會飲。」
translations.literal: Tenth month Wu Zi, Tian Qi invited various grand masters said: 'Chang mother has fish bean sacrifice, fortunate come meet drink.'
translations.idiomatic: On the day Wu Zi of the tenth month, Tian Qi invited the various grand masters, saying: 'Chang's mother has a fish and bean sacrifice. I am fortunate that you have come to meet and drink.'

context.previous: 陽生至齊，私匿田乞家。
context.next: 會飲，田乞盛陽生橐中，置坐中央，發橐出陽生，曰：「此乃齊君矣！」

translations.chinese: 會飲，田乞盛陽生橐中，置坐中央，發橐出陽生，曰：「此乃齊君矣！」
translations.literal: Met drank, Tian Qi filled Yang Sheng bag middle, placed seat central, opened bag exited Yang Sheng, said: 'this then Qi lord!'
translations.idiomatic: They met and drank, and Tian Qi filled Yang Sheng in a bag, placed him in the seat in the center, opened the bag and brought out Yang Sheng, and said: 'This is then the lord of Qi!'

context.previous: 十月戊子，田乞請諸大夫曰：「常之母有魚菽之祭，幸來會飲。」
context.next: 大夫皆伏謁。

translations.chinese: 大夫皆伏謁。
translations.literal: Grand masters all prostrated greeted.
translations.idiomatic: All the grand masters prostrated and greeted him.

context.previous: 會飲，田乞盛陽生橐中，置坐中央，發橐出陽生，曰：「此乃齊君矣！」
context.next: 將與大夫盟而立之，鮑牧醉，乞誣大夫曰：「吾與鮑牧謀共立陽生。」

translations.chinese: 將與大夫盟而立之，鮑牧醉，乞誣大夫曰：「吾與鮑牧謀共立陽生。」
translations.literal: About to with grand masters ally and establish him, Bao Mu drunk, Qi slandered grand masters said: 'I with Bao Mu plotted together establish Yang Sheng.'
translations.idiomatic: They were about to ally with the grand masters and establish him, but Bao Mu was drunk, and Qi slandered the grand masters, saying: 'I plotted together with Bao Mu to establish Yang Sheng.'

context.previous: 大夫皆伏謁。
context.next: 鮑牧怒曰：「子忘景公之命乎？」

translations.chinese: 鮑牧怒曰：「子忘景公之命乎？」
translations.literal: Bao Mu angered said: 'you forget Jing Gong command?'
translations.idiomatic: Bao Mu was angered and said: 'Have you forgotten Duke Jing's command?'

context.previous: 將與大夫盟而立之，鮑牧醉，乞誣大夫曰：「吾與鮑牧謀共立陽生。」
context.next: 諸大夫相視欲悔，陽生前，頓首曰：「可則立之，否則已。」

translations.chinese: 諸大夫相視欲悔，陽生前，頓首曰：「可則立之，否則已。」
translations.literal: Various grand masters mutually looked wanted regret, Yang Sheng forward, knocked head said: 'can then establish him, not then stop.'
translations.idiomatic: The various grand masters looked at each other and wanted to regret, and Yang Sheng came forward, knocked his head, and said: 'If it is permissible, then establish him. If not, then stop.'

context.previous: 鮑牧怒曰：「子忘景公之命乎？」
context.next: 鮑牧恐禍起，乃復曰：「皆景公子也，何為不可！」

translations.chinese: 鮑牧恐禍起，乃復曰：「皆景公子也，何為不可！」
translations.literal: Bao Mu feared calamity arise, then again said: 'all Jing Gong sons also, why not permissible!'
translations.idiomatic: Bao Mu feared that the calamity would arise, and then again said: 'They are all sons of Duke Jing. Why is it not permissible!'

context.previous: 諸大夫相視欲悔，陽生前，頓首曰：「可則立之，否則已。」
context.next: 乃與盟，立陽生，是為悼公。

translations.chinese: 乃與盟，立陽生，是為悼公。
translations.literal: Then with allied, established Yang Sheng, this was Dao Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Then they allied and established Yang Sheng. This was Duke Dao.

context.previous: 鮑牧恐禍起，乃復曰：「皆景公子也，何為不可！」
context.next: 悼公入宮，使人遷晏孺子於駘，殺之幕下，而逐孺子母芮子。

translations.chinese: 悼公入宮，使人遷晏孺子於駘，殺之幕下，而逐孺子母芮子。
translations.literal: Dao Gong entered palace, made people move Yan Ru Zi to Dai, killed him tent below, and expelled Ru Zi mother Rui Zi.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Dao entered the palace, made people move Yan Ruzi to Dai, killed him under the tent, and expelled Ruzi's mother Rui Zi.

context.previous: 乃與盟，立陽生，是為悼公。
context.next: 芮子故賤而孺子少，故無權，國人輕之。

translations.chinese: 芮子故賤而孺子少，故無權，國人輕之。
translations.literal: Rui Zi originally base and Ru Zi young, therefore no power, state people slighted him.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Zi was originally base and Ruzi was young, and therefore they had no power, and the people of the state slighted them.

context.previous: 悼公入宮，使人遷晏孺子於駘，殺之幕下，而逐孺子母芮子。

translations.chinese: 悼公元年，齊伐魯，取讙、闡。
translations.literal: Dao Gong first year, Qi attacked Lu, took Huan, Chan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duke Dao, Qi attacked Lu and took Huan and Chan.

context.next: 初，陽生亡在魯，季康子以其妹妻之。

translations.chinese: 初，陽生亡在魯，季康子以其妹妻之。
translations.literal: Initially, Yang Sheng fled in Lu, Ji Kang Zi with his younger sister married him.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Yang Sheng fled in Lu, and Ji Kangzi married him with the younger sister.

context.previous: 悼公元年，齊伐魯，取讙、闡。
context.next: 及歸即位，使迎之。

translations.chinese: 及歸即位，使迎之。
translations.literal: And returned ascended throne, sent welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: And when he returned and ascended the throne, he sent to welcome her.

context.previous: 初，陽生亡在魯，季康子以其妹妻之。
context.next: 季姬與季魴侯通，言其情，魯弗敢與，故齊伐魯，竟迎季姬。

translations.chinese: 季姬與季魴侯通，言其情，魯弗敢與，故齊伐魯，竟迎季姬。
translations.literal: Ji Ji with Ji Fang Hou had relations, spoke their feelings, Lu not dared give, therefore Qi attacked Lu, finally welcomed Ji Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ji had relations with Ji Fanghou, spoke of the feelings, and Lu did not dare to give her, and therefore Qi attacked Lu, and finally welcomed Ji Ji.

context.previous: 及歸即位，使迎之。
context.next: 季姬嬖，齊復歸魯侵地。

translations.chinese: 季姬嬖，齊復歸魯侵地。
translations.literal: Ji Ji favored, Qi again returned Lu invaded lands.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ji was favored, and Qi again returned the invaded lands of Lu.

context.previous: 季姬與季魴侯通，言其情，魯弗敢與，故齊伐魯，竟迎季姬。

translations.chinese: 鮑子與悼公有郤，不善。
translations.literal: Bao Zi with Dao Gong had enmity, not good.
translations.idiomatic: Baozi had enmity with Duke Dao, and it was not good.

context.next: 四年，吳、魯伐齊南方。

translations.chinese: 四年，吳、魯伐齊南方。
translations.literal: Fourth year, Wu, Lu attacked Qi southern.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wu and Lu attacked the southern part of Qi.

context.previous: 鮑子與悼公有郤，不善。
context.next: 鮑子弒悼公，赴于吳。

translations.chinese: 鮑子弒悼公，赴于吳。
translations.literal: Bao Zi assassinated Dao Gong, fled to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Baozi assassinated Duke Dao and fled to Wu.

context.previous: 四年，吳、魯伐齊南方。
context.next: 吳王夫差哭於軍門外三日，將從海入討齊。

translations.chinese: 吳王夫差哭於軍門外三日，將從海入討齊。
translations.literal: Wu king Fu Chai cried army gate outside three days, about to from sea enter punish Qi.
translations.idiomatic: King Fuchai of Wu cried outside the army gate for three days, and was about to enter from the sea to punish Qi.

context.previous: 鮑子弒悼公，赴于吳。
context.next: 齊人敗之，吳師乃去。

translations.chinese: 齊人敗之，吳師乃去。
translations.literal: Qi people defeated them, Wu troops then left.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qi defeated them, and the troops of Wu then left.

context.previous: 吳王夫差哭於軍門外三日，將從海入討齊。
